messages:
Maya (Marketing): Hey team — finalizing the public announce for tomorrow. Need: changelog blurb, docs link, and final rollout timing. Can we confirm canary window and webinar slot? :eyes:
Jon (Eng): Can do. Changelog PR is open, but want to verify the runtime patch note. I'll paste a short blurb in a sec.
Sam (PM): Rollout plan: canary starts 08:00 UTC, 30m monitor, then 50% for 1h before full. Can push earlier if needed.
Nora (Docs): Docs are in staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release/v1.4.2 — will publish on green. I can drop the public link once Deploy is complete.
Maya (Marketing): Perfect — canary 08:00 UTC works for the announce at 09:00 UTC? We want docs live + changelog posted before send.
Jon (Eng): 09:00 UTC is fine. Changelog short blurb (WIP):
```
Fixed KV cache stalling under high-concurrency; improved latency at tail percentiles; added quantized kernel for xFormers-compat models.
```
Maya (Marketing): Nice. Can you make a 1-sentence line for the top of the changelog we can use in the email/social?
Jon (Eng): Sure: "Reduced 99th-percentile latency for long-context workloads and added a new quantized kernel to lower CPU/GPU costs for common open models."
Aria (Growth): Also need the webinar RSVP link to feed inbound. We're routing demo requests to sales@redwood.ai + short form. Use this tracking URL: https://app.hubspot.com/forms/demo?campaign=release_v1.4.2
Maya (Marketing): Add that to the announcement and API docs header. Also want 2 benchmark bullets: percent latency improvement and cost reduction estimate. Jon, can you supply numbers?
Jon (Eng): Preliminary bench vs previous release: 15-25% lower tail latency on 16k context tests; token cost down ~12% with new caching heuristics. Put ranges in Marketing copy.
Nora (Docs): I'll update the quickstart and the changelog page with those bullets. Will include code snippet for config toggles in staging: 
```yaml
serving:
  kv_cache: enabled
  quantization_profile: s8_fast
```
Lucas (SRE): Heads up — if we hit a spike during announce we should fallback to the smaller model variant. Canary policy already has an auto-fallback rule. I'll ensure the routing policy is active at 08:00.
Sam (PM): Action list: Jon final changelog blurb + PR merge by 07:30 UTC; Nora publish docs by 08:45 UTC; Lucas verify routing/fallback before 07:50 UTC; Aria confirm HubSpot form and UTM tags; Maya prepare final copy and schedule 08:55 send.
Maya (Marketing): I'll draft the social/email copy now. Quick ask: can I get a 1-line technical quote from an engineer for the announcement? e.g., "This release reduces tail latency by X and cuts token cost".
Jon (Eng): Use: "This release reduces tail latency up to 25% on long-context workloads and lowers per-token compute by ~12% for common inference patterns."
DeployBot: deploy scheduled by DeployBot for 2024-06-14T08:00:00Z — canary rollout initialized.
Lucas (SRE): Confirmed routing policy live. I'll monitor metrics and ping here if anything looks off.
Nora (Docs): Docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v1.4.2 — changelog and quickstart updated.
Aria (Growth): HubSpot form check complete, UTM params set: utm_campaign=release_v1.4.2&utm_source=announce. Demo routing to Sales queue ready.
Maya (Marketing): Great work. I'll send the announce at 09:00 UTC. Final checklist: changelog one-liner (Jon) ✅, docs link (Nora) ✅, deploy canary (DeployBot) ✅, webinar/demo form (Aria) ✅, routing/fallback (Lucas) ✅. Thanks all! :tada:
